upstream.fetch_method: git fetch --depth 1 origin <commit>; git checkout FETCH_HEAD; HEAD rev-parse == pinned_commit (verified)

vendored_source_files.note: Reviewed C/C++/CUDA source + build file + README + LICENSE, byte-identical to upstream at the pinned commit (hashes below match the upstream objects) EXCEPT RCKangaroo.cpp which carries the adapter patch.

RESULTS.TXT.reason: Upstream RESULTS.TXT contains a recovered private key in plaintext. Excluded by policy: no recovered-key material is vendored, logged, or shipped. The patch also removes the code that writes this file.

kernel_sm89.cubin.reason: Prebuilt opaque GPU binary (turbo kernel for sm_89 / RTX 4xxx). Not source; not rebuildable from the vendored .cu (upstream turbo kernels come from the proprietary RCAsm toolchain). Hash recorded; an entrant who needs the turbo path must fetch and verify it against this hash from the pinned commit on their own private GPU host.

kernel_sm120.cubin.reason: Prebuilt opaque GPU binary (turbo kernel for sm_120 / RTX 5xxx). Same rationale as kernel_sm89.cubin.

RCKangaroo.sln.reason: Visual Studio solution; not needed for the CMake/Linux source build.

RCKangaroo.vcxproj.reason: Visual Studio project; not needed for the CMake/Linux source build.

RCKangaroo.vcxproj.user.reason: Visual Studio per-user settings; not needed.

asm_note: The *.asm files are upstream RCAsm turbo-kernel sources. They are vendored for review/provenance but are NOT consumed by the CMake build, which compiles RCGpuCore.cu. They cannot be assembled without upstream's RCAsm toolchain and are not required for a working (non-turbo) CUDA build.
patch_summary: Redirects the recovered key to an inherited --candidate-fd as 32 big-endian bytes, fails closed on any sink error, removes the stdout 'PRIVATE KEY' print and the RESULTS.TXT writer, and requires --candidate-fd before real/main-mode solving. See patches/0001-candidate-fd-key-sink.patch.
verification: Vendored upstream file hashes equal the upstream objects at the pinned commit (confirmed during vendoring). SHA256SUMS.txt lists the exact shipped bytes.
